    <h1>Kim jesteśmy</h1>

    <h2>Practical Design</h2>

    <p>Jesteśmy grupą mieszkańców otuliny Puszczy Zielonki i pobliskich miejscowości oraz miłośnikami jezior i lasów tego regionu.
        Ostatnio zjednoczył nas protest przeciwko rażącemu zakłócaniu ciszy i spokoju domowego przez samolot latający nad naszymi domami, startujący z lotniska w Bednarach..</p>

    <a href="https://oneflow-jekyll-theme-example-one.github.io/" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow" target="_blank" class="btn btn--primary">
        Theme Example Website One
    </a>
    <a href="https://oneflow-jekyll-theme-example-two.github.io/" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow" target="_blank" class="btn btn--primary">
        Theme Example Website Two
    </a>

    OneFlow is licensed under the <a href="https://opensource.org/license/mit/" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow" target="_blank">MIT License</a>.
    That means, you can freely copy, use and customize it - whatever you like!

<section class="site-section alternative-color" id="section-3">

    <h1>This is OneFlow Jekyll Theme. Section 3</h1>

    <h2>Easy customization</h2>

    <h3>Color skins</h3>

    OneFlow offers various color skins, easily settable in the <code>_config.yml</code> file.

    <h3>Masthead</h3>

    The masthead is set to sticky, so it always stays visible. You can easily change that in the <code>_config.yml</code> file. <br>
    You can also set the opacity of the masthead there.<br>
    Of course, the navigation links also can easily be changed, in <code>/_data/navigation.yml</code>.<br>
    The masthead can show your logo, the site title or the site title + a subtitle.

    <h3>Footer</h3>

    The links, copyright and creator in the footer can easily be set in the <code>_config.yml</code> file.

    <h3>Custom stylesheet, custom fonts</h3>
    Add your own styles in <code>/assets/css/custom-styles.css</code>,
    <span style="font-family: 'Great Vibes';"> and easily apply any font you want. </span>

    <h3>Cookie / cdn-usage consent banner</h3>
    OneFlow comes with a build-in popup banner that you can easily turn on and off plus customize to suit your needs.
    The existing version of the popup is a suggestion and should (no legal advice given) fulfill german laws regarding
    cookie and cdn-usage consent.

</section>







<hr class="section-sep">








<section class="site-section" id="section-4">

    <h1>This is OneFlow Jekyll Theme. Section 4</h1>

    <h2>Easy local build with docker</h2>

    OneFlow comes with build-in docker configuration using
    <a href="https://github.com/BretFisher/jekyll-serve" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow" target="_blank">BretFisher's jekyll serve</a>.
    Just open up a terminal, navigate to your site and run <code>docker-compose up</code>. Easy as that.

    <h2>Client editables</h2>

    <!--

-->

Are you a Web Developer and using OneFlow to build a site for a client?
If the client him/herself regularly wants to change certain parts of the site, for example upcoming dates,
OneFlow offers easy editables within Jekyll's <code>/_includes</code> folder, so the client does not have to touch
the rest of the site, but can still edit whatever he/she needs to edit.

    <h2>HTML and Markdown</h2>

    Use raw and flexible HTML or clear markdown to write your content.
    Markdown is rendered with <a href="https://kramdown.gettalong.org/" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow" target="_blank">kramdown</a>,
    which supports applying css classes to the Markdown. That means, you can add notices, boxes and other utilities even to your Markdown content,
    as simple as <code>"Text you want to add the classes to {: .class1 .class2}"</code>.

    <h2>Icons with Font Awesome</h2>

    Add icons anywhere, using <a href="https://fontawesome.com/" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow" target="_blank"><i class="fa-solid fa-font-awesome"></i> Font Awesome</a>.
    Locally hosted and directly build into OneFlow, ready to be applied.

    <h2>Responsive design</h2>

    All of OneFlows features are 100% responsive and adapt to different screen sizes, so your site looks good
    on all devices!
